tools.name: validate_strategy_demo
tools.description: Free demo of the paid strategy-validation check. Send periodic NET returns as decimals (0.01 = 1%); only the first 60 observations and 300 bootstrap resamples are used. Returns annualised Sharpe, block-bootstrap 95% CI, probabilistic and deflated Sharpe (corrects for n_trials), max drawdown, min tra

tools.name: dataset_sample
tools.description: Free headline numbers from two precomputed datasets: Aave v3 liquidation statistics (Base/Ethereum) and a flash-loan arbitrage FEASIBILITY study (negative result: 0 profitable of 552 simulated executions). Research data, not trading advice.

tools.name: paid_api_terms
tools.description: Returns the URLs, methods, prices and x402 payment terms (USDC on Base) of the full paid endpoints: POST /v1/validate ($0.10), GET /v1/liquidations ($0.01), GET /v1/flashloans ($0.02). Call those over HTTP with an x402 client; this MCP server does not take payment.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: paid_api_terms · Private data: validate_strategy_demo · Public sink: validate_strategy_demo, paid_api_terms.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: paid_api_terms · Private data: validate_strategy_demo · Public sink: validate_strategy_demo, paid_api_terms

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
